title: Report a problem
subtitle: Share what happened and the app’s logs — identifiers are removed unless you choose to keep them.
placeholder: What were you doing? What did you expect?
keepHelp: Only turn this on if the maintainer asked for them.
nothingSent: Nothing is sent until you choose where to share it.

note.saved: Thanks — bundle saved to the app folder as {{file}}.
note.saveFailed: The bundle could not be saved. See More → Error log for details.
note.issue: The issue opens in your browser with the summary filled in (the VIN and adapter address are always removed there). Attach the JSON bundle to it for the full logs.
note.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. See More → Error log for details.
note.email: Your email app opens with a draft. Attach the JSON bundle from Share bundle.
note.emailFailed: No email app could be opened. Share the bundle instead.
